issue.title: Ended agent sessions should show their outcome (Merged, Review approved, Stopped by close-out) instead of a bare "Session ended"
acceptanceCriteria: Every surface listed above shows the derived outcome label for an ended session, with the plain "Session ended" text used only when no outcome can be derived.
Only "Ended unexpectedly" uses an attention color; normal outcomes follow the style guide's quiet treatment (the `pan-style-guide` skill).
The outcome is derived at read time from existing facts; no new persisted status field.
Unit tests cover each outcome mapping, including the fallback.
Docs: update `docs/ISSUE-VIEW.md` (and any user-facing page that describes agent states) with the outcome labels.

blocker.title: Operator Stop renders red "Ended unexpectedly" in a live session
